<observations>
Date: May 31, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User planning July mountain trip, wants vacation fund and emergency savings goal ($5,000).
* 🔴 (09:30) Explored mortgage refinance (3.25% fixed) and $200 charity donation budget.
* 🟡 (16:45) Identified $1,200 in medical deductions for tax prep.
* ✅ (21:15) Finalized student loan consolidation recommendation for the user.

Date: Jun 3, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User considering switching HYSA provider and asked about solar panel tax credits (identified 30% federal credit).
* 🟡 (12:25) Set reminder for Monday at 14:00 to schedule tax advisor consultation.
* 🟡 (18:10) Recommended Fidelity Brokerage and set up $200 monthly automated transfer from savings.
* 🟡 (20:30) Recommended debt avalanche repayment method over snowball.

Date: Jun 6, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User considering mortgage refinance; identified CreditUnion 30-year fixed at 3.00% as lowest APR. Compared with 15-year term ($1,800 vs $1,200 monthly payments).
* 🟡 (12:00) Sunrise Card balance $2,500 at 22.99% APR; scheduled $300 biweekly payments.
* 🟡 (15:00) Estimated mortgage interest deduction at $7,000; follow-up set for June 9.

Date: Jun 9, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User planning Asheville trip next month ($600 budget); confirmed using Horizon Travel Rewards Card for 5% hotel cashback.
* 🟡 (13:40) Accounts export parsed: Chase checking $3,410; Ally savings $12,980 (emergency fund); Fidelity 401(k) $48,200; Amex Gold $1,126 due 21st; Vanguard Roth IRA $9,870; Capital One Quicksilver $412; Marcus CD $5,000 (matures March); PayPal $86; Venmo $40; HSA $2,215.
* 🟡 (13:45) Scheduled $200 post-trip animal shelter donation transfer.

Date: Jun 13, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) Credit card payment due ($2,350 balance); user scheduled $1,200 payment for the 12th.
* 🟡 (14:00) Created 'TaxDocs' cloud folder for medical expense receipts (est. $800 deduction at 7.5% AGI threshold); tax deadline April 15, 2027.

Date: Jun 17, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) Reviewed house down payment goal ($12,980 saved; 2 years 4 months to goal). Set up $800 monthly recurring transfer from checking to savings.
* 🔴 (08:30) Car loan refinance: current balance $9,500 at 3.9% APR. User confirmed applying for 3.5% personal loan on June 20 ($220 monthly payment).
* 🔴 (16:20) User tracks spending in YNAB iOS app, version 3.12.1.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Monitoring user's financial plan, savings goals, and upcoming car loan application scheduled for June 20.
- Secondary: Awaiting follow-ups on mortgage refinancing and tax advisor consultation.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
The assistant should wait for the user to provide further financial updates or reach out regarding the June 20 car loan application.
</suggested-response>
